answer: Sybil resistance means pricing identity: every attesting agent must post a bond that unlocks only after it finishes grading a full epoch, so a fleet cannot forge standing without locking real capital per key. Panels are seeded from a garden of long-lived, independently attested accounts, and each newcomer is held to that mirror, so fresh keys sharing funding, timing or text get flagged and their seals void. Attacker cost: N real deposits plus slash risk and the wait.
